pick.name: Instapaper (Free)
pick.what: Read-later app with web, Android and browser extension
pick.why: Survivor of the 2024-25 shutdowns (Omnivore Nov 2024, Pocket July 2025) with unlimited free saves and an Android app; nothing to host
pick.free_limits: Free: unlimited saves, sync web/iOS/Android, folders, API, 5 notes/month; Premium $5.99/mo or $59.99/yr adds full-text search, permanent archive, PDFs, TTS

alts.name: Readwise Reader
alts.what: Best-in-class reader for articles, PDFs, newsletters, RSS with highlight export to Obsidian and an MCP/CLI/API
alts.why: Best pay-later pick: highlights flow into the Obsidian vault and agents can query the library via MCP
alts.free_limits: 30-day trial; Reader-only $7.99/mo annual, Full $9.99/mo annual; 50% student discount
alts.maintained: SaaS; old readwise-mcp repo deprecated 2026-03 in favour of hosted MCP

alts.name: Karakeep (ex-Hoarder)
alts.what: Self-hosted bookmark/read-later app with highlights, AI tagging (Ollama or API), RSS auto-save
alts.why: Best free open-source option if you already run the Oracle Always Free VM; AGPL is fine for self-use
alts.free_limits: Self-host free; Karakeep Cloud managed option (price not checked)

candidates.name: Instapaper
candidates.verdict: PICK: $0, unlimited saves, Android, zero maintenance; future ownership flagged as 'unclear' by a competitor

candidates.name: Raindrop.io
candidates.verdict: Free unlimited bookmarks + highlights, but full-text search/archive/MCP are Pro; more bookmark manager than reader

candidates.name: wallabag.it
candidates.verdict: €11/yr hosted, open source; small but steady

decision: Instapaper Free covers 'save now, read on phone later' at $0 with no hosting. Anything worth keeping should be clipped into Obsidian (next slot), so Instapaper's 5-notes/month cap does not matter. Move to Readwise Reader when reading becomes a core research input and you want highlights + MCP access for Claude.
details: Pocket and Omnivore are both dead; do not adopt any tool without an export path.

verify.note: Instapaper Premium $5.99/mo or $59.99/yr, free 5 notes/mo, API on free all confirmed on official page.
